findings.issue: Piel imperative 2mp is a command; “Cocerán” is future indicative. Person and stem match; mood/force does not.
Locative “a” is grammatical smoothing; the token is a construct noun (opening), not a preposition.
“reunión” states the meeting sense; the noun also licenses appointed time/place, which is not stated.
אתו is 3ms; “la” is feminine so it agrees with carne, grammatical smoothing with the same singular referent.

notes: 2mp comerán is ustedes address; 3mp lo comerán matches the quote; verbless אשר has no unmarked copula.
